IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Hunter, Alexander, Kagi, and Darneille

Bill.BriefDescription: Extending the sunset review and termination date for the office of public defense.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to extending the sunset review and termination datefor the office of public defense; and amending RCW 43.131.389 and43.131.390.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.131.389 and 1998 c 108 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The office of public defense and its powers and duties shall beterminated on June 30, ((2008)) 2023, as provided in RCW 43.131.390.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.131.390 and 1998 c 108 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts, as now existing or hereafteramended, are each repealed, effective June 30, ((2009)) 2024: (1) RCW 2.70.005 and 1996 c 221 s 1; (2) RCW 2.70.010 and 1996 c 221 s 2; (3) RCW 2.70.020 and 1996 c 221 s 3; (4) RCW 2.70.030 and 2005 c 111 s 1 and 1996 c 221 s 4; and p. 1 HB 2926 (5) RCW 2.70.040 and 1996 c 221 s 5.
